notes.title: 📢 Closed Beta Patch Notes – v0.46.09.03
notes.content:
⚡ Network Performance Improvements

Overall network performance has been greatly improved.

Expect lower latency, fewer sync issues, and smoother multiplayer sessions.

Adjusted and optimized for a more immersive horror experience.

🚪 Interactive Objects

Doors, drawers, and other interactive objects now sync more smoothly across the network.

Animations feel more responsive and fluid.

Enemy AI network performance improved.

More stable and consistent movement/animations.

notes.title: 📢 Patch Notes – v.0.44.01
notes.content:
📢 Patch Notes – v.0.44.01

A fresh update is here! This patch focuses on improving user experience and fixing several annoying issues. Here’s what’s new:

🔄 Return to Lobby System
You can now return directly to the lobby after a match ends. No more jumping back to the main menu — just hit the button and get ready for the next round with your team!

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Invite Menu Update
Player names in the invite menu will now be truncated with “...” if they exceed 10 characters, keeping the UI clean and readable.

🔊 Audio Mute Fixes
Several sound effects that were not muting correctly have been fixed. Your volume controls should now behave as expected.

⚙️ Unified DLSS Settings
DLSS settings are now routed through a single unified control point. This ensures better compatibility and smoother configuration.

🕊️ Bird & Jump Bug Fixes
Bugs related to bird animations and the jump mechanic have been addressed. Expect smoother behavior during gameplay.

📦 Jump Animation Added to Props
Props now respond to jump actions with proper animations, enhancing environmental interactivity.

🚀 Optimization Improvements
Performance optimizations are ongoing. Current focus is on improving the experience on High quality settings — early results look promising!
[hr][/hr]
Your feedback helps us a ton!
Reach out via \[discord.gg/trianglect] and help shape the future of Triangle Cursed Town. 🎮

Thanks for playing — and good hunting!
— Triangle Cursed Town Dev Team

notes.title: 📢 CLosed Beta Test UPTADE – v.0.39.000
notes.content:
📢 Beta Test – v.0.39.000🔥 Difficulty Modes & System Improvements
Hey Investigators,
Big changes are here! With this Beta Update, we’re laying the groundwork for more dynamic, scalable gameplay. Choose your difficulty, explore the improvements, and help us test what’s coming next.
[hr][/hr]🎮 New Difficulty Modes: Easy / Medium / Hard
You can now select your preferred challenge level directly from the updated UI!
[hr][/hr]
⚙️ Difficulty-Based Adjustments:

📡 EMF Behavior: Spawn chance and detection range now scale with difficulty.

🔦 UV & Spectral Traces: Easier modes offer more clues, harder ones demand sharper eyes.

🧠 Sanity Drain: Duration and loss rates are now difficulty-dependent.

👹 Demon Hunt Speed: Faster and more aggressive on Hard.

⏱️ Hunt Start Delay: Shorter delays on harder settings = less time to react.

🎲 Hunt Trigger Chance: More frequent in higher difficulties.

✅ Translation Fixes & Green Info Screens: Minor localization improvements and new difficulty-specific info panels.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Fixes & Experimental Features:
🧩 Phase 2 Entry Bug: Fixed issue where players couldn't enter Phase 2 after dying. Needs further testing.

🧍 Lobby Overlap Glitch: Fixed overlapping player models in the lobby. Still under test.

⚙️ DLSS & VSync Options Added (Experimental): These features are now available in settings but are not fully functional yet — in progress.
[hr][/hr]
💬 We're in active testing — your feedback is crucial!
Join our Discord or contact us via email to report bugs or share suggestions.

👻 Stay sharp and good hunting,
– Triangle Cursed Town Dev Team
